scope: Gathering version-2 documentation, live WithAName collection, MISP 3.0 feed ingestion and refreshed screenshots. Other chapter examples retain their separately recorded revisions.

misp.role: Site administrator in an isolated local documentation database

module_service.runtime: Checked-out module source running with the existing Python 3.12 documentation-container dependencies; current proxy and CA bundle supplied, with TLS verification enabled.

collection.data: Actual public historical source configurations; no synthetic replacement or source-response mocking. Listed target systems were not contacted.

verification.feed_created_via: Authenticated MISP POST /feeds/add in a fresh MISP 3.0 database
verification.feed_fetched_via: Authenticated MISP POST /feeds/fetchFromFeed/3, synchronous MISP importer with background generation in misp-modules

gathering_contract_tests.skip_reason: Optional GATHERING_TEST_ARCHIVE fixture was not supplied.

verification.source_availability: The public source intermittently exceeded the producer's 15-second read timeout. Failed generation was reported to MISP and its job was released; a subsequent live attempt completed successfully.
remaining_limits: The saved Overmind form was inspected without submitting changes; feed creation and fetch were validated through the authenticated API.
Database-backed scheduled background feed workers were not exercised.
Restart recovery, historical source corrections and large-feed budgets were source-reviewed rather than rerun for this documentation change.

capture_method: Headless system Chromium via Playwright against the running local MISP application. Actual saved feed edit modal and actual imported event list; no DOM data substitution, image generation or image retouching.

shots.description: Saved MISP 3.0 feed opened in the actual edit modal; the screenshot stops before Save Changes.
Actual imported MISP 3.0 snapshot events. The built-in column chooser hides tags/galaxies, correlations, reports and last-change columns to keep source timestamps readable.
